title: Moment 3: Inbox, Drafted replies, never sent without a yes
intro: A short made-up storyboard from endgame.life. Priya clears forty messages in five minutes. Nothing here is real and nothing is sent.

steps.say: Made-up example, nothing is sent. Priya's inbox sorts 40 messages: 3 need a reply, 5 are waiting, and 32 are for information only.
A short draft to the agency is ready in her voice: thanks, I can deliver Thursday.
She can edit it, and Send waits for her.
Only when Priya taps Send does anything leave.
